A, B, N = map(float, input().split())
min_error = 1e9
res_num = 0
res_den = 1

for i in range(1, int(N) + 1):
    val = (A * i) / B
    floor_val = int(val // 1)
    if abs(A / B - floor_val / i) < min_error:
        min_error = abs(A / B - floor_val / i)
        res_num = floor_val
        res_den = i
    ceil_val = int(-(-val // 1))  # equivalent to ceil
    if abs(A / B - ceil_val / i) < min_error:
        min_error = abs(A / B - ceil_val / i)
        res_num = ceil_val
        res_den = i

print(f"{res_num}/{res_den}")
</translated_code>
